implementation.consumer: Complete-turn preflight remains zero-effect. For an accepted all-navigation batch, the function invoker remains serial and each callback first obtains exactly one durable reservation using the latest store-returned cursor.
implementation.binding: The exact returned ordinal is combined only with server-owned current job/pair versions and lease authorization; model arguments and tool-call IDs remain unchanged for callback invocation and provider replay.
implementation.failure: A null, stale, or failed first/later reservation terminates before the affected and later callbacks and before another provider request.
implementation.receipt: A closed server-only reserved-navigation port carries the ticket to the typed receipt sink; PreparedPass1Store returns the receipt ID and replacement cursor from CommitReservedNavigationReceiptAsync without incrementing ToolAttemptCount again.
implementation.cumulative_state: Each later reservation sees the preceding committed response's accepted/evidence counters and only the latest returned ticket.

boundary_extension: Exact receipt-ticket propagation required minimal Core updates to the reservation ticket, navigation response/port, and closed prepared contracts plus an explicit PreparedPass1Store receipt-sink implementation. This avoids an Agents-to-Infrastructure dependency and the legacy double-increment path; no DI registration, schema, migration, provider, or source scope changed.
privacy: The reservation and replacement tickets are server-only and absent from provider-visible arguments, request bodies, logs, and durable source evidence. No provider, database, network, credential, host setting, or system configuration was accessed or changed.
warnings: Existing NU1507 and EF assembly-version warnings remain; focused and broader tests succeeded.
